page.title: Backlog
page.noPlanned: No planned sprints. Create one to start planning.
page.noMatchMessage: Try a different search, or remove a filter.
page.emptyMessage: Add the work you want to do. You can plan it into sprints later, or drag a todo here.
page.reorderLock: Clear filters to reorder the backlog
page.reorderOff: Reordering is off while filters are active. {{reason}}. You can still move todos to a sprint from their menu.

sprint.empty: No todos in this sprint yet. Drag todos here, or use a todo’s menu and choose “Move to {{name}}”.
sprint.deleteWithTodos: {{todos}} will return to the end of the backlog.

start.title: Start {{name}}
start.onlyPlanned: Only planned sprints can be started.
start.stillActive: “{{name}}” is still active. Complete it before starting another sprint.
start.endBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date

dnd.instructions: To pick up a todo, press Space or Enter on its reorder button. Use the arrow keys to move it within a list or into another list. Press Space or Enter to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
dnd.droppedOutside: {{key}} was dropped outside a list and stays where it was.
dnd.cancelled: Move cancelled. {{key}} stays where it was.
dnd.handleTooltipReorder: Drag to reorder, or press Space
dnd.handleTooltipMove: Drag to move, or press Space
